reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the cell-type annotation transfer use-case batch for use-case-cell-type-annotation-transfer: 175 records (92 results, 46 evaluations, 23 configurations, 4 claims including 2 relevance judgements, 3 models, 2 datasets, 2 protocols, 2 sources, 1 method). The article XML and the Additional file 3 workbook were re-downloaded and match their recorded SHA-256 (nothing is archived: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0). Only Supplementary Tables S2 and S3 were read; the donor-level Table S6 was not read or extracted, and the downloaded workbook was deleted after the check. All 92 results match. Changes are listed in docs/reviews/use-cases/cell-type-annotation-transfer-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any model.
Figures (including Fig. 3 and Fig. S19 to S23) were not checked; the screened sources in research.md were not re-read.
Judgement pins are not set; they are computed by the integrator after the records are in the store.

errors.message: Source-wide evidence concern replaced by a limitation: Tables S2 and S3 agree with each other; only Results paragraph 4 reverses the full-ensemble comparison.
metric_qualifier said 'over the 14 shared cell types'; Methods say 'across all classes' without naming the class set for cross-atlas transfer. Qualifier now says so.

limitations now name the atlas label columns, the OnClass training and test design, the figure-only rejection results (Fig. S22, Fig. 3e, Fig. S23), where each baseline appears, and the absent spread.

Origin independent_paper is right (no author overlap with the scored models' listed authors; no competing interests declared). Ensemble uses_model links match every table row. UCE, LangCell and scCello have no existing family record in main or any worktree; the stored ucc-research-method-uce is a scTab method identity.
